Hollis's message was just a reminder, so I replied in the thread under it in #central-team. The reply says expense reports are due Friday, Oct 16, and offers to add a reminder to the team calendar. I didn't create the calendar entry because they hadn't asked for one.

I searched the notes for anything on expense reports and found nothing relevant. That search ran in a limited keyword-only mode, so it may have missed something.
